quests.title: Te Bach in Patagonia
quests.summary: Hear how the Welsh came to Patagonia, from three people who know, then show the Chief Bard a rhea.

steps.text: Hear about the Mimosa from the Museum Keeper in the old station.
Hear the Tehuelche side from the weaver by the fields.
Learn a Welsh word from the teacher by the school.
Catch a choiquet on the steppe and show the Chief Bard, then take her challenge.

quests.reward: Torta negra, a mate gourd, a Gaiman shawl (a Gale charm) and standing with Kin Abroad.
